page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a running head at the top; below the text a dedication signature block centred; faint show-through text from the reverse page in the lower half (not transcribed). No margin notes.

main_text.p: prudētia pia, in quib. præcipue internus & extern honor viuit, quib. addo flagrātem amorem erga literas & literatos, mea etiā experientia comprobatum. Quod si igitur non respuas, animi grati mei, quod offero, qualecunq; ἀγαλμάτιον, sed ea manu capias, qua mente offertur, spero Te officiosi animi observantiam sensurum. Vale, Dominus Iesus Te Tuag omnia, quam diutissime & quam benignissime, salua & incolumia conseruet & tueatur, Stadæ dabam anno 1600. Mense Augusti.
Honori tuo ab omni officio deditiss. Otho Casmannus S. R.

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse page is present throughout the lower half and is not transcribed. The signature mark "ASSER-" at the foot is taken as the gathering-line catchword-style signature as printed. Greek word ἀγαλμάτιον is copied as seen; the line "Honori tuo ab omni / officio deditiss." is set in larger type, possibly a heading-like dedication line.
